system.description:
This is a specialized legal skill dealing only with ecclesiastical law. Church Law is quite different than civil or courtly law. The punishments for crimes are religious in nature, not monetary or corporal.

Obstacles: Jurisdiction, Ob 1. Sentencing, Ob 2. Calling a council or issuing edict or bull, Ob 3. System of tithe, Ob 4. Interpreting scripture, Ob 5.

Skill Type: School of Thought. Tools: No.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 264
